title: Validate and dispatch one complete Space details replacement

requirements.invariant: One details replacement binds exact AccountID, stable SpaceID and the edit's exact ExpectedSpaceRevision. Display text, route, provider path, copied scope, readiness, as-of time, query fingerprint or cached-status metadata cannot define identity or substitute for the exact revision concurrency evidence.

Submitted display name is nonblank after outer-whitespace removal. Optional notes use the same normalization, nil or whitespace-only means absent, accepted interior text and duplicate names are preserved, and no default, uniqueness query or unapproved length cap exists.

UpdateSpaceDetails replaces the complete mutable name-and-optional-notes pair for one Space revision. It is not a patch, carries no original/base name-or-notes values and decides no dirty/unchanged/no-op policy; it cannot change scope, lifecycle, checklist, template, Item, review, media or accounting state.

A non-Codable SpaceDetailsUpdateFormInput retains caller-supplied transient raw name/notes plus exact Account/Space/base revision. Immutable replacement changes only the selected raw field; validatedIntent reuses canonical values but adds no Operation identity, readiness/lifecycle policy, authorization, persistence, fingerprint or restart claim.

SpaceDetailsUpdateUseCase receives raw form input plus caller OperationID, PrincipalID, operation contract version and finite capture time; revalidates; constructs the verified SpaceDetailsUpdateDraft/UpdateSpaceDetailsCommand; invokes SpaceDetailsUpdating exactly once only after validation; validates the receipt; preserves exact local state, Swift CancellationError and normalized SpaceCreationFailure/SpaceDetailsUpdateFailure values; and maps unexpected transport errors to SpaceDetailsUpdateFailure.localAcceptanceFailed.

This target-only slice maps only save-intent normalization and dispatch. The full source surface SWIFT-9F4789704808 remains target_mapped because initial population, transient UI state, immediate errors, dirty/no-op policy, success/cancel dismissal, layout/copy and composition remain unconverted.

Exactly two target-only leaves may change. SpaceCoreDetailsUpdate is only a future composition dependency: this use case consumes no read/readiness snapshot and decides no waiting/partial/stale/failure-cache/active/archived eligibility. SwiftUI, physical persistence, optimistic projection, authorization, schema/RLS/Sync, provider, MCP, migration, hosted resources, production, release and cutover do not advance.
Space details are organizational text only. Replacing them creates or changes no Transaction, occurrence, Invoice, budget contribution, payer, price or other accounting state.

items: SpaceDetailsUpdateFormInput carries exact Account/Space/expected-revision identity plus caller raw name and optional notes, is non-Codable, and supports immutable raw-field replacement without defaults or policy.
validatedIntent reuses SpaceDisplayName and SpaceCreationNotes only; it requires no Space directory/readiness evidence and does no operation or authorization work.
SpaceDetailsUpdateUseCase adds caller operation metadata, constructs the verified complete-replacement command, invokes one SpaceDetailsUpdating call after validation and validates the exact receipt.

Swift CancellationError remains concurrency control flow; normalized SpaceCreationFailure and SpaceDetailsUpdateFailure values remain stable; unexpected transport errors map to SpaceDetailsUpdateFailure.localAcceptanceFailed.
The current modal's newline-only acceptance hole is corrected by canonical whitespace-and-newline validation, while every remaining UI responsibility stays target_mapped.

verification.expected: Exact empty/nil/whitespace/padded/interior-whitespace/long raw name and notes remain transient. Canonical conversion rejects empty, spaces-only and newline-only names; trims only outer whitespace/newlines; maps nil/empty/whitespace notes to absent; preserves interior text; and invents no default or length cap.

Immutable raw-field replacement preserves exact Account/Space/base revision; revisions zero and UInt64.max are valid exact evidence; two distinct Space IDs may use the same canonical name without any directory query; input/intent expose no readiness, lifecycle, scope, child, accounting, authorization or backend field.

Raw input through application assembly invokes exactly one deterministic port call with one complete canonical name/notes payload and exactly one same-Space expected-revision precondition, then returns every matching OperationReceipt local state unchanged. The command carries and invokes no accounting value or operation; this provider-free test makes no claim about physical side effects.

A reciprocal matrix asserts exact Account, Space, revision, raw name/notes, Operation, actor, contract and time forwarding plus derived subject/fingerprint/precondition. Blank name and nonfinite time cause zero port calls; valid input causes one. No original/base name-or-notes value, dirty/unchanged/no-op decision, readiness, as-of, query-fingerprint or cached-status metadata exists.

Receipt mismatch and distinct normalized SpaceCreationFailure/SpaceDetailsUpdateFailure values remain stable; unexpected raw transport errors become localAcceptanceFailed; Swift CancellationError remains cancellation. Stable diagnostics reveal no raw form values, identity, credentials or provider payload. Separate reflected/encoded shape checks prove only the authorized canonical identity/text/operation fields exist and no provider/UI/readiness/lifecycle/child/accounting or production field is introduced.

The exact implementation commit passes traceability, source/provider isolation, generated contracts, focused and complete tests, warnings-as-errors, repeatable project generation, both staging builds and clean artifacts while implementation changes only the two target leaves and the current modal/caller/Firebase files remain untouched and target_mapped.
